qualityRationale.evidence: Every material claim is supported, precisely vendor-attributed or bounded as inference. Exact event metadata and volatile availability were rechecked; the remaining limitation is the absence of hands-on or independent product-performance evidence, which the article states clearly.
qualityRationale.context: The article uses independent launch reporting, METR methodology, OWASP memory risk and NIST authority work without implying any of them tested Hunter. It separates calendar persistence from reliability and specification visibility from runtime enforcement.
qualityRationale.originalValue: The story converts an announcement into a concrete pilot design covering terminal states, recovery, aged context, authority expiry, duplicate signals and matched business outcomes.
qualityRationale.voice: The completed voice edit produces direct, calm Australian English with a specific opening, natural section development and restrained vendor attribution.
qualityRationale.presentation: Title, description, takeaways, byline, exact disclosure, source list, accessible inline SVG and testing limitation align with the final copy. Desktop and mobile responsive rendering passed on the exact reviewed digest.

researchLimitations: Documentation-only analysis; Index Us did not access or test Agentforce, Hunter, Salesforce customer environments or pilot telemetry.
Salesforce capability, adoption and customer-outcome figures remain attributed vendor claims.
SiliconANGLE independently confirms the launch structure and Hunter-only runtime availability at launch but does not independently test the runtime or customer results.
The open Agent Script repository exposes the specification and tooling, while its README says the managed execution runtime is not open source.
